title: Real Estate Service Contracts — Plan Entry Gates by Property and Order Type
content:
Each Real Estate Service Contracts plan may be ordered only for a property and an order type within that plan's entry gate. The gate is read against the property type, unit count and square footage stated on the order.

## Entry gate schedule

| Plan | Property types accepted | Maximum dwelling units | Maximum living area | Order types accepted | Certificate of occupancy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | single-family, townhome, condominium, multi-unit | 4 | 9999 sq ft | listing with seller coverage; buyer-only | no requirement |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | single-family, townhome, condominium, multi-unit | 4 | 9999 sq ft | listing with seller coverage; buyer-only | no requirement |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | single-family, townhome, condominium, multi-unit | 4 | 9999 sq ft | listing with seller coverage; buyer-only | no requirement |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | single-family, townhome, condominium, multi-unit | 4 | 9999 sq ft | listing with seller coverage; buyer-only | no requirement |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | single-family, townhome, condominium, multi-unit | 4 | 9999 sq ft | listing with seller coverage; buyer-only | no requirement |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | single-family, townhome, condominium | 1 | 9999 sq ft | buyer-only | dated within 365 days before closing |

## Reading the gate

- A multi-unit property is accepted on the five Bridgewell Closing plans up to four dwelling units; the Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan accepts one dwelling unit only and does not accept a multi-unit property.
- The living-area ceiling is 9999 sq ft on every plan: a home of 9999 sq ft is within the gate, a home of 10000 sq ft is not.
- A listing order with seller coverage is within the gate of the five Bridgewell Closing plans only; the Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan is ordered buyer-only.
- For the Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan, the home's certificate of occupancy must be dated no more than 365 days before closing.

## Illustrations (hypothetical properties)

| Hypothetical property and order | Bridgewell Closing Plus | Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |
|---|---|---|
| Single-family home, 1 unit, 3200 sq ft, buyer-only | within the gate | within the gate if the certificate of occupancy date also qualifies |
| Duplex (multi-unit), 2 units, buyer-only | within the gate | outside the gate |
| Condominium, 1 unit, listing with seller coverage | within the gate | outside the gate (order type) |
| Single-family home, 1 unit, 10400 sq ft | outside the gate | outside the gate |
